market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is a minor candidate from a small left-wing party with no nationally competitive polling numbers. In Brazilian presidential elections, second place always goes to a major establishment candidate (e.g., Bolsonaro, Haddad). The likelihood of Renan Santos finishing second is negligible, making the market's implied 6.7% probability far too high.
evidence_points: Renan Santos was a fringe candidate for UP in 2022 with <1% of the vote.
Current 2026 polling data shows Lula and Tarcísio/Bolsonaro dominating; Renan Santos is not listed among top candidates.
Historical precedent: No minor-party candidate has ever finished in the top two in a Brazilian presidential election.
sources_consulted: Political analysis from major Brazilian media outlets
